_source.ins_note: INS numbers (used on Indian labels) are taken as the E-number digits (E322 -> INS 322); INS and E numbering coincide for these additives.

_policy: Category (functional class) only. No health claims are derived from this file.

non_nutritive_sweeteners.definition: Additives in the taxonomy's 'sweetener' class EXCEPT polyols/bulk sweeteners (sorbitol E420, mannitol E421, isomalt E953, polyglycitol syrup E964, maltitol E965, lactitol E966, xylitol E967, erythritol E968; polyols as listed in FSSAI Labelling FAQ Q28) and tagatose (E963, a nutritive sugar).
non_nutritive_sweeteners.caveat: The official Nutri-Score list of non-nutritive sweeteners is in the Nutri-Score Questions & Answers document, which was not available; this definition is an approximation.
